zh.title: Avolon 將 33 架客機售予 Lesha Bank　機隊分租給 25 家航空公司
zh.summary: 交易完成後將由 Lesha Aviation Services 管理，Lesha 的受管航空資產規模預計超過 75 架。
body: Avolon 與卡達 Lesha Bank 於 2026 年 9 月 28 日宣布達成協議，由 Lesha 收購一批 33 架商用飛機。這些飛機目前租給 25 家航空公司，交易仍須滿足一般交割條件。
Lesha 表示，交易完成後，相關飛機將由 Lesha Aviation Services 管理，其受管航空機隊將擴大至超過 75 架。雙方沒有在公告中揭露交易價格。
這是一項帶租約的資產組合交易，並不表示 33 架飛機會立即更換營運航空公司。現有承租人將依各自租約繼續營運，後續交割時間與個別機型配置仍以交易完成為準。

en.title: Avolon agrees sale of 33-aircraft portfolio to Lesha Bank
en.summary: The aircraft are leased to 25 airlines and will be managed by Lesha Aviation Services after closing.
body: Avolon and Qatar-based Lesha Bank announced on September 28, 2026 that they had agreed the sale of a portfolio of 33 commercial aircraft. The aircraft are leased to 25 airlines, and the transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions.

Lesha says the portfolio will be managed by Lesha Aviation Services and will increase its managed aviation fleet to more than 75 aircraft after completion. Neither party disclosed the transaction value in its announcement.

This is a sale of aircraft with existing leases, so it does not mean the 33 aircraft will immediately change operating airlines. Current lessees continue under their respective agreements, while final timing and portfolio composition remain subject to closing.

facts.claim: Avolon agreed to sell 33 commercial aircraft leased to 25 airlines to Lesha Bank.
Lesha Aviation Services will manage the portfolio after closing.
Lesha's managed aviation fleet is expected to exceed 75 aircraft after completion; no price was disclosed.
